asked: # hub-only-look — apps take their appearance from axHub, period Brett's rule (Nov 1 2026, verbatim): "The apps should only get appearance from axhub period." Also: "if you select design package in one app it changes it for all! Any theme change applies to all." Today the look is the shared document `shared/settings/appearance.json` on axHub's data server (framework `HubAppearanceSource`, runtime `attachAppearanceSource` / `applyAppearance` / `pushAppearance`). PR #224 (1156332c) already made a hub-applied look bring the console back to its Main tab and closed the Active assets pane by default. This build removes every remaining way an app shows a look that did not come from axHub. ## Do 1. **Remove the follow switch.** `APPEARANCE_FOLLOW_KEY` (`axf.hub.appearance.follow`), `appearanceFollowing` / `setAppearanceFollowing` / `syncAppearanceFollow`, the `appearance.hub` action, the "Get the look from axHub" row in framework/libs/settings, framework/libs/hubstatus, help packs (framework.json + app copies). A developer app with a source always reads and writes the hub. Clear any saved `false` value on start (one-time migration, logged to the terminal). 2. **Console interface tabs** (`apps/console-web/src/interfaceTabs.tsx`, `InterfaceScope`): tabs that draw the app under an interface's own look break the rule. Remove the GizmoX Night / AmberX Signature look tabs from the console's main window (Main only; the tab bar goes when there is one tab). Choosing an interface still works through `applyInterface`, which goes to the hub. Keep the `scoped()` runtime API only if something else still needs it; if nothing does, remove it with its tests. Default `console.interfaceTabs` = []. 3. **Dev escape hatch** `AXF_APPEARANCE_HUB=off` / `appearanceHub: 'off'` in the console server and `apps/console-web/src/hubAppearance.tsx`: remove. No hub = the waiting screen, as already decided Oct 20 2026. 4. **Every AmberX app attaches the hub source unconditionally** (`axhub-web`, `console-web`, `amberx-droid`, `patches-web`, `walkthrough-studio`, `demo` if it is one of Brett's apps — check its manifest): no `if (manifest.developer?.hub)` gate; the hub address defaults to `DEFAULT_HUB`. The hubsync lib's `off` look state goes (keep `own` = source attached by the app itself; it's still the hub). 5. **Look tweaks that stay on one device** (Sliders, per-asset tokens: `isAppearanceSetting` keys, anything with `scope: 'device'` that changes how the app looks): they must reach the hub and apply in every app. Either carry them in appearance@1 (extend the schema + parse/merge + Kotlin) or make sure the hub settings mirror carries them to every app; pick one, say why in the report. Help mode / connection settings stay per device (not appearance). 6. **Design package from any app = all apps.** Confirm the package's settings plan (`packageSettingsPlan`) and extras reach the other apps, not just its slots. Add a test: apply a design package in runtime A, feed the written doc to runtime B, B ends with the same active slots, spacing, hidden chrome and package settings. 7. **Android/Kotlin port**: mirror 1, 4, 5 in `framework/android` (and the inspector toggle from PR #224: setting `axf.inspector.shown`, closed by default). Fixtures in framework/spec where the engines have them. 8. Re-bake apps (`node framework/cli/rebake.mjs status` then `apply`; Patches only if its edited files can be moved into the framework, else leave it and say so). Typecheck console-web and axhub-web (`npx tsc --noEmit`). 9. Spec: update framework/spec/APPEARANCE-SOURCE.md with the rule in one line at the top. ## Don't - Don't change the hub document path, the data server, or the waiting-screen behaviour. - Don't touch the agent-swarm builds or anything in section 4 of the Nov 1 handoff. - Don't print secrets; never cat `/opt/axf/.axf-console/secrets.env`. ## Finish Commit on this branch (clean messages), report at `_claude/builds/reports/hub-only-look.md` (what was removed, the choice in 5, be…
